outline:
*此課程由訪問學者, 美國Boeing波音公司吳勇為博士授課, 上課時間: 9/16-12/16 每週二/四16:10~18:00.
本課程為研究所課程，介紹卡爾曼濾波器的基本理論和實際應用，並提供具體的案例來說明，包括GPS導航、綜合慣性導航、使用GPS載波相位進行精確導航、太空船之慣性姿態控制、航天器定軌、高精度時鐘、以及雷達/激光目標跟蹤等。同時進一步通過計算機實驗，使用MATLAB來幫助學員增加實務應用上的經驗。
schedule:
*此課程由訪問學者, 美國Boeing波音公司吳勇為博士授課, 上課時間: 9/16-12/16 每週二/四16:10~18:00.
(1) Reviews of mathematics
o Review of vectors & matrices
o Review of linear system theory
‧ Frequency domain representation
‧ Time domain representation
o Review of probability & random process theory

(2) Basic estimation theory
o Deterministic estimation – least squared and weighted least squared estimates
o Probabilistic estimation – maximum likelihood and Baysian estimates
o Stochastic estimation – Wiener filter
o Kalman-Bucy filter

(3) Kalman filter theory & practical application considerations
o Continuous Kalman filter: from discrete to continuous
o Special cases
▪ Correlated process and measurement noises
▪ Correlated measurement noises
o Solution of the Riccati equation; steady state Riccati equation
o Kalman-Bucy filter
▪ Orthogonal projection principle
▪ Wiener filter/Kalman-Bucy filter relationship
o Design examples
▪ First-order Kalman filter design
▪ Second-order Kalman filter design
o Adaptive Kalman filter
▪ Use of innovation process
▪ Use of real-time parameter identification
o Kalman filter implementation considerations
▪ Modeling problems: filter divergence
▪ Filter divergence solutions
- Estimate un-modeled states
- Add process noise
- Finite memory filtering
- The  technique
o Constraints imposed by the computer
▪ Computation complexity
▪ Finite word length effect
o Numerical stability & alternative forms
▪ Joseph formulation
▪ Square root formulation
▪ UDUT covariance factorization formulation
o Kalman filter: architecture and algorithm

(4) Case Studies
o Case study 1: Kalman filter for precision clock
o Case study 2: Precision air-borne IR sensor LOS attitude determination and calibration
o Case study 3: Kalman filter for Stellar Inertial Attitude Determination (SIAD)
o Case study 4: Kalman filter for RF Antenna Pointing/Acquisition/Tracking
o Case study 5: Bearing only target tracking
o Case study 6: Kalman filter for Integrated Strap-Down Inertial Navigation

(5) Computer Lab Sessions
o 1: Design & analysis of Kalman filter for precision clock
o 2: Hands-On Lab Session on Bearing Only Tracking problems
o 3: Hands-On Lab Session on 2D-GPS
